title: Navigation prototypes
html:
Choose how project sections should feel

Two working navigation options

ASections stay at the left
BSections run across the top
css: .t2-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#182033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t2-shell header p{margin:0;color:#687386;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em}.t2-shell header h2{margin:2px 0 12px;font-size:19px}.t2-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;min-width:0}.t2-option{min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:13px;padding:10px;overflow:hidden}.t2-label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;min-width:0}.t2-label strong{display:grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;background:#172033;color:white;flex:0 0 auto}.t2-label span{font-weight:650;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t2-left-demo,.t2-top-demo{height:188px;border:1px solid #d9dee8;border-radius:10px;background:#fbfcfe;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0}.t2-left-demo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(82px,31%) minmax(0,1fr)}.t2-left-demo nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:8px;background:#eef2f7;border-right:1px solid #d9dee8;min-width:0}.t2-top-demo{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr)}.t2-top-demo nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:7px;background:#eef2f7;border-bottom:1px solid #d9dee8;min-width:0}.t2-shell nav button{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:#4f5a6d;font:inherit;font-weight:650;padding:7px 6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}.t2-left-demo nav button{text-align:left}.t2-shell nav button.is-on{background:#fff;color:#2447bd;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #17203314}.t2-preview{padding:12px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}.t2-preview h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:15px}.t2-preview p{margin:0 0 7px;color:#596579}.t2-preview ul{margin:0;padding-left:17px}.t2-chip{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;background:#e8eefc;color:#294ca9;padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px}@media(max-width:690px){.t2-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t2-left-demo,.t2-top-demo{height:164px}}
js: const copy={Overview:{title:'Overview',body:'See the project at a glance.',detail:'Progress, ownership, and the next milestone stay together.'},Tasks:{title:'Tasks',body:'Work from the current queue.',detail:'Open items are ready to search, sort, and edit.'},Notes:{title:'Notes',body:'Keep project context close.',detail:'Decisions and reminders live with the project.'}};root.querySelectorAll('[data-demo]').forEach(demo=>{const preview=demo.querySelector('[data-preview]');const buttons=[...demo.querySelectorAll('button[data-section]')];function show(section){buttons.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('is-on',b.dataset.section===section));const c=copy[section];preview.replaceChildren();const h=document.createElement('h3');h.textContent=c.title;const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=c.body;const d=document.createElement('p');d.textContent=c.detail;const chip=document.createElement('span');chip.className='t2-chip';chip.textContent='Showing '+section;preview.append(h,p,d,chip);}buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>show(b.dataset.section)));show('Overview');});api.log(2,'Both navigation prototypes are interactive');
